svg.title: Tourism - Recreation and Culture - HON. BILL REID, MINISTER
svg.desc: Rebuilt historical British Columbia identity. Straightened artwork master. Existing PofBC flag curves adapted to the reference, three closed wave stripes, and carefully spaced italic serif lettering. All artwork, including lettering, is editable vector paths; no fonts or raster images required.
